svg.title: Centred enclosed cable passage in nominal 2×6 timber
svg.desc: The historical development detail uses a 38.1 millimetre circular hole centred 69.85 millimetres from the panel-contact face in 139.7 millimetre deep timber. It leaves 50.8 millimetres of wood toward each depth edge. The hole runs across the 38.1 millimetre member thickness. This diagram supplies no strength or machining release.

g.text: Enclosed LED passage — historical detail reused
Hole axis crosses the 38.1-mm member thickness, perpendicular to this view.
Dashed circle: recorded 12.7-mm maximum harness diameter; actual feeding remains unverified.
DEVELOPMENT GEOMETRY — strength, tolerances and installation remain to be established.
